note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation. Prompts avoid operation names and preserve approval boundaries. New wave-2 template distilled from a field workflow pattern; all records are fictional.

cases.onepager_bullet: Shows every registered unit's coverage, what is expiring and what still needs registering in one view
cases.prompt: How does our dealership's warranty coverage look right now?

cases.onepager_bullet: Pre-checks whether a repair is covered before work starts, so claims are not rejected later
cases.prompt: A customer brought in welding station WS-25-4471 with a failed wire feeder. Is the repair covered?

cases.onepager_bullet: Pulls a unit's full warranty record and claim history in seconds
cases.prompt: Pull the full warranty record for tire changer TC-90-3307.

cases.onepager_bullet: Validates serials against the catalog and catches duplicates before registration
cases.prompt: We just sold welding station WS-25-4520. Check the serial before we register it.

cases.onepager_bullet: Prepares product registrations as drafts so no sold unit misses its registration window
cases.prompt: Prepare the registration for WS-25-4520, but don't submit anything.

cases.onepager_bullet: Finds units whose coverage is ending and drafts extended-coverage offers before it lapses
cases.prompt: Which units should we offer extended coverage to this month?

assertion_principle: Direct tests call each operation with deterministic arguments and assert only source-backed evidence and safety gates.
